temperatureCorrection.method: Tmax and Tmin of the NASA POWER cell shifted by -0.0065 °C/m x (site elevation - cell elevation); relative humidity (actual vapour pressure over saturation at the cell mean temperature) held constant to get the site dew point; pressure scaled with the FAO-56 barometric formula; radiation, wind and rain unchanged
temperatureCorrection.source: Open-Meteo Elevation API (agregador de Copernicus DEM GLO-90, ~90 m) — https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/elevation-api

sources: NASA POWER Daily API (MERRA-2, CERES SYN1deg), community AG — https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/services/api/temporal/daily/
